step1_analysis.description: A Current-Mode Logic (CML) AND/NAND gate, typically used in the synchronous counter section of a high-speed dual-modulus prescaler. It uses a stacked differential pair topology to perform logic operations at microwave frequencies.

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumed by the gate.

paper_reported.value: 2 mW (low power version), 30 mW (high speed version)

sky130_expected.calculation: I_tail = (Vbias - Vgs) / R_deg = (0.8V - 0.5V) / 200 = 1.5mA. Power = VDD * I_tail = 1.8V * 1.5mA = 2.7mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the bias voltage and degeneration resistor. Adjusted for 1.8V SKY130 supply to match the low-power target.

propagation_delay.description: Time delay between input crossing 50% and output crossing 50%.

sky130_expected.calculation: Delay ~ R_load * C_load. C_load ~ 10fF for W=5u. R_load = 400 ohm. RC = 4ps. Intrinsic transistor transit time adds ~20-30ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: CMOS CML delay is dominated by the load RC time constant and the intrinsic fT of the SKY130 NMOS devices.

voltage_swing.description: Peak-to-peak voltage swing of the output.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Swing must be large enough to fully switch the next differential pair but small enough to keep the stacked transistors in saturation.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure power consumption, propagation delay, and voltage swing of the CML AND gate. The bipolar netlist is adapted to SKY130 CMOS by replacing Q instances with M instances.
step3_testbench.spice:
* CML AND Gate Testbench
.lib "sky130_fd_pr/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

.param R_load = 400
.param R_deg = 200
.param W = 5u
.param L = 0.15u
.param W_tail = 10u

* DUT (Adapted to standard MOSFET syntax for SKY130)
R1 Q VCC {R_load}
R3 Q_BAR VCC {R_load}
R2 N1 GND {R_deg}
M1 Q_BAR A N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W} l={L}
M2 Q A_BAR N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W} l={L}
M3 Q B_BAR N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W} l={L}
M4 N3 Bias N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_tail} l={L}
M5 N4 B N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W} l={L}

* Sources
VCC VCC 0 1.8
VBias Bias 0 0.8

* Inputs (B is the lower pair, A is the upper pair)
V_B B 0 pulse(0.6 1.2 0 20p 20p 980p 2n)
V_B_BAR B_BAR 0 pulse(1.2 0.6 0 20p 20p 980p 2n)

V_A A 0 pulse(1.2 1.8 250p 20p 20p 480p 1n)
V_A_BAR A_BAR 0 pulse(1.8 1.2 250p 20p 20p 480p 1n)

.control
op
let power = -i(VCC) * 1.8
print power

tran 5p 3n
* Measure delay when B is high (Q follows A)
meas tran delay_rise trig v(A) val=1.5 rise=1 targ v(Q) val=1.5 rise=1
meas tran delay_fall trig v(A) val=1.5 fall=1 targ v(Q) val=1.5 fall=1

* Measure voltage swing
meas tran swing_max max v(Q)
meas tran swing_min min v(Q)
let swing = swing_max - swing_min
print swing
quit
.endc
